title: Residue-field tests determine lowest fibre ranks
statement: Let $S,T$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], with derived categories in one universe [def-pc-derived-category], and $E\in D(\mathcal O_S)$ perfect [def-pc-perfect-complex]. Let $a,b\in\mathbf Z$, and assume $H^i(E\otimes^{\mathbf L}F)=0$ for every module sheaf $F$ and every $i<a$ or $b<i$ [def-pc-derived-tensor-cohomology-vanishes]. Fix $h:T\to S$, $r\in\mathbf N$, and suppose $H^a(L(h\circ i_t)^*E)$ is finite locally free of rank $r$ [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module] for every residue morphism $i_t:\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(t)\to T$ [def-pc-derived-pullback]. Then at every $t\in T$, $\beta_i(E,h(t))=0$ for all $i<a$ and $\beta_a(E,h(t))=r$ [def-sc-derived-fiber-betti]. No condition $a\le b$ is assumed.

source.place: First paragraph; Tag 0BDI base-change formula, Tag 09U8 Tor amplitude under pullback, Tag 08E9 affine criterion

proof.text: Replace b by max(a,b). Extend any test sheaf on an affine open by open pushforward; its restriction is the original sheaf. Exact restriction commutes with tensor and homology, so the global Tor tests imply the same tests on that affine. A perfect local module representative satisfies the affine Tor-amplitude criterion. Tensor it with the residue field to get zero cohomology in every degree below a, hence zero Betti numbers there. This is the flat-representative pullback argument of Stacks 09U8, specialized to residue morphisms. No b>=a assumption is needed after enlarging b.

The residue-field test and derived composition identify the degree-a cohomology of the fibre of Lh*E as rank-r locally free on Spec kappa(t). A nonempty member of its trivializing open cover equals this one-point spectrum, so the sheaf is free of rank r. Its sections, with scalars transported along GammaSpecIso, have dimension r. Since perfect objects are pseudo-coherent, apply the base-change clause of the jump-loci theorem to identify this dimension with beta_a(E,h(t)).

theorem universalLowest_fiber_ranks
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    (S : Scheme.{u})
    [∀ U : S.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings S.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (E : schemeDerivedCategory S) (hE : IsPerfect S E) (a b : ℤ)
    (hamp : ∀ F : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace),
      ∀ i : ℤ, i < a ∨ b < i → schemeDerivedTensorCohomologyVanishes S E F i)
    (r : ℕ) (T : Scheme.{u}) (h : T ⟶ S)
    (hres : ∀ t : T,
      SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u}
        ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (T.residueField t)).toRingedSpace)) a).obj
            ((derivedPullback (T.fromSpecResidueField t ≫ h)).obj E)) r) :
    ∀ t : T, (∀ i : ℤ, i < a → derivedFiberBetti S E i (h t) = 0) ∧
      derivedFiberBetti S E a (h t) = r
